# flow_kubernetes_node (Data Source)

a node of a cluster. the platform creates and names the nodes, so look one up by its role or name



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `cluster_id` (Number) unique identifier of the cluster

### Optional

- `id` (Number) unique identifier of the node
- `name` (String) name of the node
- `role` (String) only match a node that carries this role, for example `control-plane` or `worker`. a role held by more than one node needs a second filter

### Read-Only

- `network_id` (Number) unique identifier of the network the node is attached to
- `private_ip` (String) private IP address of the node
- `product_id` (Number) unique identifier of the node product
- `public_ip` (String) public IP address of the node, unset if it has none
- `roles` (List of String) roles of the node, as stable keys
- `status` (String) current status of the node, as a stable key
